cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-draw-circle-round.title: Draw a magic circle round the crucible
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-draw-circle-round.description: A magic circle is drawn around the crucible.

cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-arrange-figures-i.title: Arrange figures of nine materials in the crucible
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-arrange-figures-i.description: Figures of tamarisk, cedar, tallow, wax, husks, bitumen, gypsum, clay and dough are placed in order in the crucible.

cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-identify-figures-.title: Point at the figures and name them as the doer
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-identify-figures-.description: Reciting the incantation "this effigy of the doer", the practitioner stretches a finger toward the figures.

cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-set-torch-on-fat-.title: Put a torch on the tallow and wax figures
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-set-torch-on-fat-.description: With a further incantation, a torch is put on the tallow and wax figures.

cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-insert-woods-and-.title: Stick cedar, cypress, myrtle and reed into it
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-insert-woods-and-.description: Cedar, cypress, myrtle(?) and good reed are stuck into its interior and something is sprinkled.

cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-light-torch-from-.title: Light the torch from sulphur fire and recite
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-light-torch-from-.description: The torch is lit in a sulphur fire, and the incantation "I lift the torch" is recited.

cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-throw-fire-into-c.title: Throw fire into the crucible
cmawro-q002713-9-22-31-throw-fire-into-c.description: Fire is thrown into the crucible, burning the figures set in it.
